nodes.title: No net knock-down on CLmax
nodes.text: Design CLmax = 1.0 x the critical-section CLmax built on the XFOIL clmax envelope
nodes.basis: XFOIL tends to over-predict clmax at Re 2-3e5 by a few per cent, while the critical-section method under-predicts a low-AR rectangular wing (stall spreads before CL peaks) and the clmax envelope is already the lower of Re 2.3e5 / 3.0e5; the biases offset. Replaced by the slow-flight stall T-B2-STALL

nodes.title: Dive speed 1.3 x cruise
nodes.text: Elevon hinge moments are sized at 1.3 x cruise speed with full 25 deg travel
nodes.basis: R-SERVO-TORQUE text (1.3 x cruise; 20.8 m/s at the 16 m/s cruise)

nodes.title: Inviscid hinge moment is the bound
nodes.text: Design hinge moment = XFOIL inviscid HMOM, the larger of viscous and inviscid
nodes.basis: converged viscous XFOIL values are 70-80 % of inviscid at +10..+25 deg; viscous up-deflection cases do not converge (separated), so the inviscid value is used for both directions

nodes.title: Foam over the spar >= 2 mm
nodes.text: At least 2 mm of XPS above and below the spar tube at the spar station
nodes.basis: hot-wire kerf ~1 mm plus slot tolerance; thinner foam tears when the slot is cut (G2 confirms)

nodes.title: Stall polars valid within 10 % of their Re
nodes.text: XFOIL clmax and cm used at the stall are taken from polars within 10 % of the actual stall Re
nodes.basis: S5010 clmax changes ~0.02 per 0.3e5 of Re in this band (Re 2.0-3.0e5 polars, xfoil_results.json)

nodes.title: Stall and transition speed at the gate
nodes.equation: Vs = sqrt(2 m g / (rho b c CLmax)); Vtr = 1.3 Vs; Re_s = Vs c / nu

nodes.title: Stall speed at the forward CG limit
nodes.equation: SM_fwd = SM_min + (x_aft - x_fwd)/c; CLmax_fwd = kd * interp(SM_fwd, CLmax(SM)); Vs = sqrt(2 m g / (rho b c CLmax_fwd))

nodes.title: Elevon hinge moment per servo
nodes.equation: M = C_h q c^2 (s_in + s_out), q = rho (f V)^2 / 2; T_req = SF M

nodes.title: Foam cover over the spar
nodes.equation: cover_up = zu c - (z + d/2); cover_lo = (z - d/2) - zl c; z_mid = (zu + zl) c / 2

nodes.title: Wing root bending and torsion per g
nodes.equation: M_root = (m g / 2) ybar_frac b/2; T_root = (m g / 2) t_root
